name: Threads for Claude
description:
Threads for Claude is a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Its only API is the MCP endpoint `POST https://threads-mcp.app/mcp` (JSON-RPC 2.0 over streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 bearer tokens). Tools are discovered at runtime with the MCP `tools/list` method and called with `tools/call`; their JSON schemas are also published in https://threads-mcp.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json. The other operations here are public, read-only discovery documents.

Tools that publish, reply, repost or delete act publicly on the user's behalf: show the user the exact text and get explicit confirmation before calling them.

Authentication guide: https://threads-mcp.app/auth.md. Agent overview: https://threads-mcp.app/llms.txt.
